Hey! I'm Prajwal — a passionate E&TC engineering student with a drive to merge hardware and software into intelligent systems. From accident-detecting helmets to smart solar street lights, I build things that solve real problems.

I'm obsessed with the intersection of electronics, AI, and web technology. Whether it's programming microcontrollers, developing web apps, or leveraging AI tools, I'm always exploring what's next.

My dream? To launch my own electronics startup and become a tech influencer — sharing knowledge and inspiring the next generation of engineers.
